name: Choir Tune Finder
description: An offline vocal toolkit for live tuning, blended-vocal isolation and estimated SATB practice guides.
requirements: Android 6.0+, 64-bit ARM. Demucs needs 2.5 GB available RAM; 6 GB phones recommended. Full-song isolation can take hours. SATB outputs are estimates, not isolated singers.

name: KeySense Studio
description: Explore musical keys and chords, play the piano, connect a MIDI keyboard and export your ideas.
requirements: Android 6.0+. MIDI and Bluetooth features depend on compatible hardware and permissions.

name: Bible Quiz
description: Test your knowledge with 2,500+ questions, six Bible translations and engaging offline challenges.
requirements: Android 6.0+. Bible content and questions are bundled in the app.

name: WiFi Cam
tagline: A new view from your phone.
description: Turn your Android camera into a WiFi webcam for your computer, live streams and OBS Studio.
requirements: Android 6.0+, camera permission and a shared WiFi network. See the source guide for computer/OBS setup. This download is the Android APK, not the Windows driver.

name: JS Mastery
description: Learn JavaScript with 50 topics, 350 runnable practices, quizzes and an in-app reference book.
requirements: Android 6.0+ and a recent Android System WebView.

name: Pastoral
description: Write and organize sermons, search bundled KJV scripture and keep your preparation in one place.
requirements: Android 6.0+. Works offline without a network connection.

name: KeyFinder Player
tagline: Know the key. Feel the music.
description: Play your own songs, estimate their musical key and BPM, and rehearse with waveform and A–B looping.
requirements: Android 6.0+. Audio decoding depends on device-supported codecs; key and tempo results are estimates.

name: Music Downloader
description: Find audio with Google and Openverse, or paste a direct file link and save permitted music to your phone.
requirements: Android 6.0+ and internet access. Only download recordings you are authorized to save; website availability varies.

name: NewsDesk Studio
description: Create broadcast lower thirds and control a bundled overlay toolkit, right from your Android device.
requirements: Android 6.0+ and a recent Android System WebView. See the app guide for overlay and broadcast setup.

name: Community Market
description: Browse an offline marketplace and services directory created with Monrovia communities in mind.
requirements: Android 6.0+. The bundled directory is not a live inventory, payment or delivery service.
